ESSENCE.Character.TeamCellHint: The Team this character belongs to. Click to open its sheet. To join a Team, drag this character from the Actors directory onto the Team's sheet.
ESSENCE.Character.NoTeamHint: Not on a Team yet, so Team Tier 1 applies. To join one, drag this character from the Actors directory onto a Team sheet.
ESSENCE.Sheet.NoComponentTier: No Component Tier: this item isn't built from a Chassis and Fitting, or its parts have no Tier set.
ESSENCE.Team.RaiseTooltip: Raise Team Tier by 1. Permanent: Team Tier only increases, and every member's Temporary Influence is cleared.
ESSENCE.Team.RaiseBody: {team} will rise from Team Tier {from} to {to}. Team Tier only increases, and raising it clears every member's remaining Temporary Influence:
ESSENCE.Team.RaiseNoInfluence: No member currently holds Temporary Influence.
ESSENCE.Team.CorrectTooltip: Fix a mistaken Team Tier. This is a correction, not a rules change: it clears nothing.
ESSENCE.Team.CorrectBody: Use this only to fix a mistake. It sets Team Tier directly, in either direction, without clearing anyone's Temporary Influence.
ESSENCE.Team.MissingMembers: {n} member(s) on this Team no longer exist in this world.
ESSENCE.Team.ThingsNotesPlaceholder: What the Team can do with it, what it requires, what could change it
ESSENCE.Team.OrganizationsNotesPlacehold: What they offer, what they want, what could change it
ESSENCE.Team.CharterHint: Agreed when the Team forms and revised when it changes. None of these grant mechanical benefits; they give the table a shared starting point.
ESSENCE.Team.TierHint: The Team's scale, 1 to 5. Only the GM changes it: Raise is permanent and clears every member's Temporary Influence; Correct fixes a mistake without clearing anything.
ESSENCE.Team.TierNote: Team Tier sets the Team's ordinary equipment access and the scale of meaningful costs. It grants no personal statistics.
ESSENCE.Team.TierOnlyIncreases: Team Tier only increases. The change was not saved.
ESSENCE.Team.TierGMOnly: Only the GM can change Team Tier.
ESSENCE.Team.TierRaisedChat: {team} rises from Team Tier {from} to {to}. Every member's Temporary Influence is cleared: {members}.
ESSENCE.Team.DropHint: Drag a character here from the Actors directory to add them. A character belongs to one Team.
ESSENCE.Team.ThingsHint: Significant property, vehicles, facilities, projects, debts and commitments. Note what the Team can do with it, what it requires, and what could change it.
ESSENCE.Team.OrganizationsHint: Factions, institutions, businesses and communities that matter at this Tier: what they offer, what they want, and what could change the relationship.
ESSENCE.Sheet.UsedThisAdventureHint: Used allocation stays committed for the rest of the Adventure, even if stored, lent, depleted, lost, or replaced. Only Unused items freely transfer to an equal-capacity replacement on Armory access.
ESSENCE.Sheet.ToggleItemUsedAria: Mark {name} as used or unused this Adventure
ESSENCE.Common.Label: Label
ESSENCE.Common.Name: Name
ESSENCE.Common.SizeHint: Size 0 to 5. Ordinary characters are Size 1. It describes occupied space and grants nothing else.
ESSENCE.Sheet.TokenImageTooltip: Token Image — the art shown on the canvas. Separate from the Portrait above; see the Game Master's Guide for how the two relate.
ESSENCE.Sheet.UnlockedTooltip: Sheet unlocked — click to lock Attributes/Styles/build fields again
ESSENCE.Sheet.LockedTooltip: Sheet locked — click to edit Attributes/Styles/build fields
ESSENCE.Sheet.OpenSpeciesHint: open Species — e.g. to choose Species Traits
ESSENCE.Sheet.MonsterDistinctionHint: optional — only needed to unlock a gated Combat Style (Gestalt, Magecraft, Psionics, Ritualism, Calling)
ESSENCE.Sheet.DeadNote: Dead. Death is final under the rules; only the GM can change this.
ESSENCE.Sheet.StabilizeConfirm: Stabilize {name}: are the immediate treatment requirements on the Critical Wound Card (or, for a Defeated enemy, the GM's stated care) met? Stabilization then succeeds automatically.
ESSENCE.Sheet.StabilizeNotMet: Treatment requirements for {name} were not met; the burned dice stay spent.
ESSENCE.Sheet.StabilizeNothing: {name} is not Dying, Stabilized or Defeated; nothing to stabilize.
ESSENCE.Sheet.PrepareTriggerPlaceholder: e.g. an enemy enters the doorway
ESSENCE.Sheet.PrepareReserve: Reserve how many of the remaining Action dice? (max {max})
ESSENCE.Sheet.PrepareNote: Reserved dice pay the prepared Action's commitment when it fires as your one response in a Reaction chain. They never join the Reaction Pool and are discarded at the start of your next Turn.
ESSENCE.Sheet.HelplessTarget: Target is helpless (unopposed: no Success Die reserved, every 6+ is a Surge)
ESSENCE.Sheet.DamageComponentsHint: One row per printed component, in the card's order. Each type sets its domain. A flat reduction applies once to the total, from the largest component, before Resistance, Resilience, Temporary Wounds and Core Wounds. Rows with amount 0 are ignored.
ESSENCE.Sheet.BreachHint: Skips Resilience. Resistance and Vulnerability still apply.
ESSENCE.Sheet.NonlethalHint: Only when the card, equipment or feature grants it. If this component fills the last Wound space, the target is unconscious and stable instead of Dying; its surplus Wounds do nothing.
ESSENCE.Sheet.WeakenedHint: Weakened: reduce Damage dealt by 1 per target, once to the total, before target protections.
ESSENCE.Sheet.ConcentrationWound: {name} is concentrating and suffered a Core Wound: burn 1 available Pool die or end Concentration. This is not a Reaction.
ESSENCE.Sheet.RecoverWhichWounds: Which Core Wounds recover? Each Wound Card's own requirements decide; any number may clear together.
ESSENCE.Sheet.ApplyDamageHint: Resolve incoming damage through Resilience, Temporary Wounds and Core Wounds.
ESSENCE.Sheet.RecoverWoundHint: Active healing: clear the lightest marked Core Wound and its Condition.
ESSENCE.Sheet.GrantRecoveryHint: A Recovery the GM grants when there is safety and time: restore resources and recover Wounds.
ESSENCE.Sheet.AdaptabilityRerollHint: Restored automatically by Recovery — does not stack with an unused use.
ESSENCE.Sheet.InfluenceRecoveryNote: Core Influence does not clear through ordinary Recovery — each Influence Consequence Card attached below states what actually repairs that consequence. Essence has no universal day/week/month schedule.
ESSENCE.Sheet.TemporaryWoundsAvailableHi: How many Temporary Wounds your gear and features currently grant.
ESSENCE.Sheet.ReachHint: The scale across which wealth, reputation, and connections remain meaningful — gates what Availability/Tier of Inventory Equipment this NPC can carry (see Equipment section below).
ESSENCE.Sheet.ReachPressureNote: Reach pressure recorded: {n} / {max} — Reach itself never decreases; resets at an Adventure boundary.
ESSENCE.Sheet.ExceptionalLoad: Exceptional load: {lb} lb — in addition to normal personal equipment; no Armory/Inventory capacity change.
ESSENCE.Sheet.RunningJump: Running jump: {units} units — needs a 2-unit run-up; uses normal Movement, grants none extra.
ESSENCE.Sheet.ExtremeExertion: Extreme exertion: {minutes} minutes ({rounds} Rounds) before the hazard procedure applies.
ESSENCE.Sheet.SustainedAttention: Sustained attention: {hours} hours of demanding watch/study before a strain roll.
ESSENCE.Sheet.LanguagesBenefit: Languages: one primary plus Acuity additional, {n} in total.
ESSENCE.Sheet.ConnectionsBenefit: Connections: up to {n} dependable allies (permanent Presence).
ESSENCE.Sheet.DashPrompt: Burn how many Action dice? Each burned die is 1 unit of Movement this Turn (min {min}, max {max}).
ESSENCE.Sheet.DifficultyBlank: blank: GM reads the highest die
ESSENCE.Sheet.ResetAdventureUsesTooltip: Also resets accumulated Reach pressure, every owned Function Augment's Uses, and every Consumable Kit's Equipment Card Uses
ESSENCE.Sheet.NewEncounterTooltip: Resets once-per-Encounter Combat/Reaction Card cooldowns. Starting a new Combat inside the same Encounter does NOT do this automatically — use this button explicitly.
ESSENCE.Sheet.NoBasicActions: No Basic Actions — drag Hide, Strike, etc. from the compendium.
ESSENCE.Sheet.NoActionCards: No Action Cards — drag one from the compendium.
ESSENCE.Sheet.NoBasicReactions: No Basic Reactions — drag Brace, etc. from the compendium.
ESSENCE.Sheet.NoReactionCards: No Reaction Cards — drag one from the compendium.
ESSENCE.Sheet.EquipmentCardsHint: (granted by Inventory Equipment — does not count against Card Count)
ESSENCE.Sheet.OverInventoryLimitPlural: Over your Inventory Limit by {n} slots (rounded up) — pay 1 ordinary Influence pressure per extra slot to cover it. Another character may pay it instead.
ESSENCE.Sheet.OverInventoryLimitSingular: Over your Inventory Limit by {n} slot (rounded up) — pay 1 ordinary Influence pressure per extra slot to cover it. Another character may pay it instead.
ESSENCE.Sheet.AboveTeamTierException: A Component is above Team Tier even with {source}'s allowance. Obtained gear is still usable; this is only about ordinary acquisition.
ESSENCE.Sheet.AboveTeamTier: A Component is above Team Tier {tier}, beyond the Team's ordinary access. Obtained gear is still usable; this is only about ordinary acquisition.
ESSENCE.Npc.MonsterCreatorTooltip: Auto-generate or hand-build a stat block
ESSENCE.Character.ComboTooltip: Whenever you inflict Damage with a Prowess Action/Reaction, gain 1 Combo (max 5). Each Combo adds 1 Movement. Lose 1 if you dealt no Damage this Turn, or whenever you suffer a non-Temporary Wound.
ESSENCE.Character.ComboDealtDamageHint: Tick when a Prowess Action or Reaction deals at least 1 Damage this Turn. At End Turn, Combo drops by 1 if this is not ticked; a Wound not absorbed by a Temporary Wound also costs 1. Combo ends with the Encounter.
ESSENCE.Character.LockTooltip: When playing a Ballistics Action against a detected creature with a clear firing solution, burn 1 additional Action die before resolution to establish Lock; that Action can benefit from it. Normally one Lock (two with the Marksman); a new one replaces the oldest. Lock grants no universal bonus and never reveals a Hidden target. It ends when replaced, consumed, explicitly ended, at Encounter end, or at the end of your Turn if detection was lost and not restored. Click a Lock to end it.
ESSENCE.Character.LockEndHint: Click to end this Lock (replaced, consumed, or detection lost by end of Turn)
ESSENCE.Character.AdaptationTooltip: After a Gestalt Action resolves, assume its offered Adaptation or keep your current one (normally one; a new one replaces the old). At the end of each of your Turns, End Turn pays the printed Stamina upkeep for the Adaptation you hold then, or it ends. Efficient Transformation (Gifted) reduces ordinary upkeep by 1, minimum 0; Unstable adds 1 that this cannot remove. To stop maintaining a zero-upkeep Adaptation, click End before ending your Turn.
ESSENCE.Character.UpkeepDueHint: Printed upkeep, less 1 with Efficient Transformation (minimum 0), plus 1 while Unstable.
ESSENCE.Character.DeferUpkeepHint: Tick when you assume an Adaptation outside your Turn: the first upkeep is then due at the end of your next Turn, and End Turn clears this instead of charging.
ESSENCE.Character.ContingencyTooltip: A Cunning Action Rider may establish a Contingency with a Trigger and an effect. Normally establish one and trigger one per Round (the Strategist establishes two; still one trigger). At a qualifying Trigger, choose whether to perform it; declining keeps it for a later Trigger. It resolves once and ends; unused Contingencies expire at the start of your next Turn. Not a Reaction: it uses no chain response.
ESSENCE.Character.TriggerContingencyHint: The Trigger occurred and you choose to perform the effect: it resolves once and ends (one trigger per Round).
ESSENCE.Character.ContingencyTriggeredTh: A Contingency has triggered this Round.
ESSENCE.Character.ThreadsTooltip: After a Magecraft Action resolves, click its subtype to create that Thread. Hold up to 3; duplicates are allowed and their effects stack. At capacity, consume or discard one first. Declare and consume Threads before rolling a Magecraft Action or Reaction (click the ✕ chip); they stay spent if the card fails. A new Thread cannot strengthen the Action that created it. Unused Threads end with the Encounter.
ESSENCE.Character.ConsumeThreadHint: Consume this Thread (declare before the roll; stays spent if the card fails)
ESSENCE.Character.StrainTooltip: When playing a Psionics Action or Reaction you may gain 1 Strain for 1 free Surge (offered in the dice prompt; not at 6). 0-2: no penalty. 3-4: −1 Composure. 5-6: −1 Composure and each Psionics card costs 1 additional burned die, judged at the value after the gain. Forced Strain past 6 stays at 6 and deals 1 Psychic Breach Damage per excess point. Recovery clears Strain; ordinary Condition removal does not.
ESSENCE.Character.StrainBurnSurcharge: Strain 5-6: Psionics cards require 1 additional burned die.
ESSENCE.Character.VentStrainHint: During your Turn, before any Psionics Action: burn 2 Action dice to remove 2 Strain. No Psionics Actions for the rest of the Turn; Reactions remain available.
ESSENCE.Character.ForceStrainHint: A hostile effect forces Strain. Past 6 you stay at 6 and take 1 Psychic Breach Damage per excess point (applied through Apply Damage).
ESSENCE.Character.StrainVentedNote: Strain vented: no Psionics Actions this Turn.
ESSENCE.Character.AuthorityTooltip: After a Leadership Action resolves, store one actually rolled result on the card that generated it (two with the Orator). Occupied-card capacity is half Leadership Rank rounded up, minimum 1. Before an Action or Reaction roll, spend one result from any occupied card to replace one paid rolled die (one substitution per card play; the fixed die still counts toward minimum and maximum, can be the Success Die or make a Surge). A card's own Authority effect spends only results stored on that card. Burned dice and fixed results cannot generate Authority. Unused Authority ends with the Encounter.
ESSENCE.Character.StoreAuthorityHint: Capacity: {capacity} occupied card(s); each holds up to {perCard} result(s). Storing on an occupied card keeps its results unless you replace them.
ESSENCE.Character.ReplaceExisting: Discard this card's existing result(s) first
ESSENCE.Character.OratorNote: Orator: each occupied card holds up to two results; spending one leaves the other.
ESSENCE.Character.RitesTooltip: After a Ritualism Action resolves, its Rider may establish a Rite (card name, Trigger, Echo, Echo Limit). When the Trigger occurs, click Echo: the Echo resolves, remaining Echoes drop by 1, and the Rite is removed after the last. Normally maintain 3 (4 with the Invoker); adding another asks which Rite to remove, and the Invoker may resolve that Rite's Echo once as it goes (Final Echo, once per Round). Possessed: name the subject; a new same-named Rite on that subject replaces the old one. An unwilling subject can burn 3 Action dice on its Turn to sever one hostile link.
ESSENCE.Character.EchoRiteHint: The Trigger occurred: resolve the Echo and reduce the remaining Echoes by 1
ESSENCE.Character.PossessedHint: Possessed attaches this Rite to a creature (no control). It moves with the subject; a new same-named Rite on the same subject replaces this one.
ESSENCE.Character.RemoveRiteHint: Remove this Rite (ended, severed, or replaced)
ESSENCE.Character.FinalEchoOption: Final Echo: resolve the removed Rite's Echo once before removal (once per Round)
ESSENCE.Character.InvokerNote: Invoker: capacity 4; once per Round, a replaced Rite may echo once as it goes.
ESSENCE.Character.ManifestationTooltip: Use the mask icon in this sheet's header menu to fully manifest. The Rider's surcharge (extra burned Action dice and Mana by Rank; the Summoner reduces the dice by 1) is paid on entry, then your token swaps to the form's own sheet. All your forms share one five-space Manifestation Wound track; when it fills the form collapses, you return and take 1 direct Spiritual Core Wound, and you are Broken until a Recovery removes a Manifestation Wound. Return during your Turn costs 1 Action die; you must return before entering another form.
ESSENCE.Character.ManifestationTrackHint: Shared Manifestation Wound track (all forms). Full = Broken. Each Recovery removes 1.
ESSENCE.Character.NotManifested: Not manifested — use this sheet's header menu to enter.
ESSENCE.Character.BrokenHint: the shared track is full; no Full Manifestation until a Recovery removes a Manifestation Wound. Ordinary Calling cards still work.
ESSENCE.Character.ManifestationDialogHin: Play the Calling Action first. Entering then pays the Rider's surcharge automatically from your Action dice and Mana (shown per form below), and swaps your token to that form's own sheet. Return from the form's sheet (1 Action die during your Turn).
ESSENCE.Manifestation.SharedTrackHint: All of the caller's forms share these five spaces. Filling the last one collapses the form at once: surplus Wounds from that component are discarded, the caller returns and suffers 1 direct Spiritual Core Wound, and is Broken until a Recovery removes a Manifestation Wound.
ESSENCE.Manifestation.ReturnHint: During your Turn, burn 1 Action die to return to the caller. The form's Conditions and Temporary Wounds end; the shared Manifestation Wounds remain.
ESSENCE.Manifestation.RollLimitHint: The form's printed Roll Limit replaces Attribute + Style Rank for its native abilities. Free dice may exceed it.
ESSENCE.Character.LanguagesHint: One primary language plus additional languages equal to permanent Acuity: {n} in total. The Campaign defines its languages.
ESSENCE.Character.ConnectionsHint: dependable allies, up to permanent Presence
ESSENCE.Character.ConnectionsOverLimit: More Connections than permanent Presence ({n}). Relationships gained through play are unrestricted; choose which ones this benefit covers.
ESSENCE.Character.ConnectionAreaHint: Area of Involvement: this Connection's job, and what they can do for you.
ESSENCE.Character.ConnectionRelationship: Relationship: how you are related to this Connection.
ESSENCE.Character.ConnectionTierHint: The Tier of help this Connection can give, 1 to 5.
ESSENCE.Character.SecondDistinctionHint: Second Distinction, acquired through the Skill Tree. It uses its later-acquisition benefit, not its Origin Benefit, and raises its own Style's Expertise limit by 1.
ESSENCE.Character.AdvancementPointsToolt: Advancement Points spent on Skill Tree nodes (1 AP per node). Unspent AP = Level − AP Spent. Node rewards are still in playtest, so track purchases by hand.
ESSENCE.Character.AdvancementPointsOvers: AP Spent is higher than Level. Level is the total AP this character has earned, so lower AP Spent or raise Level.
ESSENCE.Character.TeamTierHint: Team Tier comes from this character's Team. The GM sets it on the Team sheet. It sets ordinary equipment access and grants no personal stats.
ESSENCE.Character.LevelHint: Level equals total Advancement Points earned. A new character has earned 1 AP (Level 1). There is no level cap.
ESSENCE.Common.PoolBonusHint: Explicit grants that raise the base Action and Reaction Pools. Both pools share one base: 6 plus this bonus.
ESSENCE.Character.ReachHint: The scale across which your wealth, reputation, and connections remain meaningful — gates what Availability/Tier of Inventory Equipment you can carry (see Equipment tab). Manually GM-awarded, not a computed formula.
ESSENCE.Character.ReachTriggerExamples: (Letters of Standing, Fence's Cache, Prepared Cache, ...)
ESSENCE.Character.ReachTriggerBreachNote: First use of each Reach Trigger per Adventure is free. Each additional use creates 1 ordinary Influence pressure: Reach absorbs it first, then Temporary Influence, then Core Influence. For Prepared Cache, set Reach+ to 0: it grants no Reach.
ESSENCE.Character.OriginFeatureTooltip: From this character's Species/Heritage/Distinction — edit it on that Item, not here.
ESSENCE.Chat.BurnOnlyNote: Automatic. No roll, no Success Die, no Surges.
ESSENCE.Item.Equipment.GrantedCardsHint: Played from the Combat tab's Equipment Cards.
ESSENCE.Chat.GmSetsDifficulty: no Difficulty declared; the GM decides from the highest die
ESSENCE.Chat.UnopposedNote: auto-success; no Success Die reserved, every 6+ is a Surge
ESSENCE.Chat.OpenRollNoteSingular: {surges} candidate die at 6+ (excluding the Success Die) — Defense wasn't declared, so the GM decides how many actually count.
ESSENCE.Chat.OpenRollNotePlural: {surges} candidate dice at 6+ (excluding the Success Die) — Defense wasn't declared, so the GM decides how many actually count.
ESSENCE.Chat.NoSurgesMook: none — Mooks do not generate Surges.
ESSENCE.Item.Augment.CompatibilityPlaceh: e.g. Any, Weapon, Requires Tier 3+ Chassis
ESSENCE.Item.Augment.FunctionHint: A Function Augment grants an Equipment Action/Reaction with limited Uses that refresh at the end of the Adventure unless stated otherwise.
ESSENCE.Item.Augment.SupportHint: A Support Augment is an always-active modifier with no Uses. Installed normally it modifies its Chassis directly; if its Mount is Linked and the Link is On, it modifies the paired Function instead.
ESSENCE.Item.Card.SurgeNote: · each other die at 6+ is one
ESSENCE.Item.Card.NoRiderReaction: No Rider. A Reaction never carries an Action Rider.
ESSENCE.Item.Equipment.AlwaysModularHint: Always assembled from a Chassis + Fitting (+ Augments) below — Fortitude/Resilience/Movement come from those pieces, not this item.
ESSENCE.Item.Equipment.UsesRefreshHint: (each card's Uses refresh at end of Adventure)
ESSENCE.Item.Equipment.AssignFreeHint: Assigning a {chassisLabel}/{fittingLabel} above is free. Use the buttons below only when the change happens formally during an Adventure and should spend its Action Dice cost.
ESSENCE.Item.Equipment.CatalogCopyHint: Entries marked Catalog aren't owned yet — picking one adds this character's own copy of it to the Armory. Parts of an assembled item don't count against Inventory or Armory capacity.
ESSENCE.Item.Equipment.NoComponentOption: No {label} available for this Category. If this is a player's sheet, check that the Equipment compendium's Ownership lets players see it.
ESSENCE.Item.Equipment.TemplateAssignHin: Assigning a {chassisLabel}/{fittingLabel}/Augments above is free while authoring a compendium template — reconfiguration dice costs only apply once a character actually owns this item.
ESSENCE.Item.Equipment.ReachExceptionHin: Leave blank — this is normally set automatically when a player uses "Choose Item" for a feature such as Quartermaster's Due. Fill it in by hand only for a one-off exception, such as exceptional loot above the Team's ordinary access.
ESSENCE.Item.Species.SubChoiceLegend: Nested sub-choice (optional — e.g. "choose two Senses" buried in this trait's own text)
ESSENCE.Item.Species.NatureOptionsPlaceh: e.g. Low-Light Vision, Keen Hearing, Keen Scent
ESSENCE.Item.Monster.TacticsHint: Ordered — follow the first instruction that applies rather than optimizing this Mook's turn.
ESSENCE.Item.Monster.LeaderAbilitiesHint: Encounter-scale abilities this Leader uses to manipulate its allies — target priorities, Tactics overrides, formations, extra activations.
ESSENCE.Item.Monster.SoloAbilitiesHint: Encounter-scale action-economy tools that let this one Elite occupy the tactical space of several combatants — extra activation windows, reactions, phases, wound-triggered changes.
ESSENCE.Item.Monster.AbilitiesHint: Plain-text Abilities available on every Grade as a supplement alongside real Combat/Reaction Cards — tag each with how often it's usable.
ESSENCE.Item.Monster.AbilityDiceHint: Mook or Normal: the printed d10s rolled, no Pool. Elite: the card-style minimum commitment. Blank: no roll.
ESSENCE.Item.Monster.EngineReduced: Reduced engine: printed rolls, Actions per Turn, Reactions per Round, no Pools or Resources.
ESSENCE.Item.Monster.EngineFull: Full engine: Pools, cards, printed costs and Roll Limit.
ESSENCE.Item.Monster.PrintedDefensesHint: An enemy's Defenses are printed, not derived. Blank keeps the Attribute-derived value.
ESSENCE.Item.Monster.EnemyRecoveryHint: Refreshes abilities limited to X between Recoveries. Combat ending, a truce or a new Initiative roll does not.
ESSENCE.Item.Monster.ShowFullStats: Show Attributes, Styles, cards and Pools (Elite-style detail)
ESSENCE.Wizard.BuildEquipmentHint: Weapons, Armor, Guards and Implements are always assembled from a Chassis + Fitting rather than picked whole. Create one here and its sheet opens so you can name it and choose its parts from the catalog.
ESSENCE.Wizard.BulkImport.Title: Bulk Import
ESSENCE.Wizard.BulkImport.NoPermission: You don't have permission to create content. Ask your GM to grant Foundry's "Create Items" permission (Configure Settings > Configure Permissions).
ESSENCE.Wizard.BulkImport.Intro: Download a CSV template, fill it out (Excel, Google Sheets, or any spreadsheet app that exports CSV), then upload it here. Matching by name: a row whose name already exists in the compendium updates that item in place; a new name creates a new one.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Content.NoPermission: You don't have permission to create content. Ask your GM to grant Foundry's "Create Items" permission (Configure Settings > Configure Permissions), or have them create it for you.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Content.Title: Create Content
ESSENCE.Wizard.Content.Intro: Choose what you're creating and give it a name. It's saved straight into the shared compendium.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Content.BodyHint: The card's printed effect, one labeled paragraph per row (e.g. Target, Effect, Range).
ESSENCE.Wizard.Content.EquipmentCardsHin: One row per granted Equipment Card — each has its own Uses, refreshing at end of Adventure.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Content.ConditionSections: One row per labeled section (e.g. EFFECT, DURATION, REMOVAL) — matches how existing Conditions read on the sheet.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Content.ChassisMountsHint: Every Chassis has at least 1 Mount (§ Augment Mounts). Set "Linked with" to another Mount's number to pair them as a Linked Mount, or leave blank for an independent Mount.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Content.CreatedInCompendi: {name} has been created in the {label} compendium.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Monster.ConceptHint: Grade sets the stat budget every later step uses — pick it first. Grade is GM-facing complexity/weight (Team Tier is not an enemy rating), Role is its battlefield job. There's no canonical formula for Grade in the rules yet, so these are tunable defaults: Mook (runs in numbers, scripted by Tactics below), Normal (a real individual fight, GM-controlled), Elite (rare, uses the full combat engine — set Elite Type once you know if it's a Champion, Leader, or Solo).
ESSENCE.Wizard.Monster.DomainEmphasisHin: Auto-Generate leans the point-buy toward this domain's Attributes and Styles — it doesn't exclude the other two.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Monster.AutoGenerateHint: Fills Attributes, Combat Styles, Resilience, Temporary Wounds, Combat Cards, and Equipment from the budget above. Safe to run again — it overwrites, doesn't add.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Monster.OriginHint: Optional — a Species or Distinction can grant passive features and unlock a gated Combat Style.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Monster.MonsterOriginHint: Monster Type is flavor, not a hard rule — pick whichever fits. Distinction is still optional, and still the only way to unlock a gated Combat Style.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Monster.GatedSkillsHint: Gestalt, Magecraft, Psionics, Ritualism, and Calling are gated — a matching Distinction is required to put points in them.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Monster.AttributesHint: Distribute {pool} points across the 9 Attributes, starting at 1 each, none above {max}.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Monster.SkillsHint: Distribute {pool} points among the 9 Combat Styles, none above Rank {max}.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Monster.WoundsHint: Order never changes: Damage → Resilience → Wounds → Temporary Wounds → Core Wounds. Auto-Generate sets these from the Grade budget; adjust freely.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Monster.FinalizeHint: No hard requirements to check here — an NPC is playable at any point. Close this wizard and open the NPC sheet whenever it's ready.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Character.ConceptHint: Decide who the character is before touching any numbers. Confirm the Team's starting Team Tier with your GM.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Character.IdentityHint: Choose a Species, Heritage, and Distinction. Base Action and Reaction Pools = 6 plus explicit grants = {pool}.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Character.GatedSkillsHint: Gestalt, Magecraft, Psionics, Ritualism, and Calling are gated — you can't invest Style Points in them without the matching Distinction.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Character.AttributesHint: Distribute {pool} points across the 9 Attributes, starting at 1 each, none above 3.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Character.SkillsHint: Distribute {pool} points among the 9 Combat Styles — no Style above Rank 2 at creation.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Character.ExpertisesHint: Each Expertise must belong to a Style rated at least 1. No per-Style limit — specialize or spread out.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Character.AssignRankHint: Assign at least 1 Rank to a Combat Style above to unlock its Expertises.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Character.NonCombatSkills: Non-Combat Skills — {spent} / {pool} points, max 2 each. Remaining: {remaining}
ESSENCE.Wizard.Character.SkillPointFormu: 5 + Intellect {intellect} + grants {bonus}; max Rank 2 at creation
ESSENCE.Wizard.Character.SkillPointBonus: Explicit Skill Point grants (from a feature's text)
ESSENCE.Wizard.Character.StartingAPHint: You gain 1 Advancement Point on top of the starting package. Level 1 with 0 spent records it as saved; if you spend it now on a Skill Tree purchase, record 1 spent and what it bought.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Character.PassiveFeatures: Species/Heritage/Distinction traits are collected automatically. Add anything else standing here (Skill Tree passives, campaign bonuses, etc.).
ESSENCE.Wizard.Character.EquipmentHint: Your Inventory Loadout is what you bring on this Adventure, up to your Inventory Equipment Limit. The Armory fills in as you play.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Character.FinalizeHint: Confirm final Resources, Defenses, and Base Action Pool, then check every requirement.
ESSENCE.Wizard.Character.WeaknessesNote: Weaknesses are intentional. Once your GM approves the sheet, you're ready to play.
ESSENCE.Settings.GradeBudgets.Title: Monster Grade Budgets
ESSENCE.Settings.GradeBudgets.Hint: Tune the homebrew stat budgets the Monster Creator uses to auto-fill a Grade (Mook/Normal/Elite).
ESSENCE.Notify.StyleRollOutsideCombat: Combat Styles are rolled through their cards. Outside Combat, roll a Non-Combat Skill, a Key Aspect, or an Attribute alone.
ESSENCE.Notify.DistinctionAlreadyHeld: {name} is already one of this character's Distinctions.

ESSENCE.Notify.PersonalTierRemoved:
Essence System v0.6 rules: characters no longer have a personal Tier.

  • Base Action and Reaction Pools are now a flat 6, raised only by explicit grants (the new Pool bonus field).
  • Level now means total Advancement Points earned; a new character is Level 1.
  • Team Tier lives on a Team actor: create one from the Actors directory and drag the characters onto it.

Nothing was converted automatically.
